newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN BCR BANK EUROBOND ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN BCR BANK EUROBOND ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED.

text.p: Romania's state bank Banca Comerciala Romana SA (BCR) said on Friday it had raised $75 million from an oversubscribed three-year Eurobond issue, launched by Merrill Lynch International .

"The original issue was worth $60 million but investors subscribed $75 million in only one day," BCR's international relations director Radu Razvan told Reuters, adding that the bank had yet to decide on the destination of the raising.
Razvan, who called the issue launched in London a success, said there had been ample demand for the bonds but the bank had settled for $75 million on interest rates grounds.
Subscription remains officially open until March 6.
The BCR manages most of Romania's industry loans. Its share capital is 225.4 billion lei, with assets at 4.7 trillion.

Moody's Investors Service assigned the BCR last month a B1 and Not-Prime for long- and short-term deposits, and a D bank financial strength rating. Its rating for short-term local currency debt, awarded by Thomson BankWatch, is LC1.
Merrill Lynch helped Romania last year to rejoin the international capital market after more than a decade of isolation imposed by the ousted communist regime.
Merill Lynch also launched a successful corporate five-year bond issue worth $150 million for the country's electricity authority Renel RA.
